name: magpie-kuku2api
description: Baidu Kuku AI provider for Magpie with the native MCP tool channel: real client tool calls, streaming chat, session reuse
author: cv-superding

summary.en: Baidu Kuku AI over the desktop MCP channel, so client tools really run. Differs from magpie-kuku-auth: that one uses the text-only web chat endpoint and refuses tools; this one drives genflowpro (sendmsg + three SSE streams + MCP callback), so a tools request becomes finish_reason tool_calls and the caller's result resumes the same turn. Streams, reuses an existing Kuku login.
summary.zh: 把百度库库 AI 接进 magpie，走桌面端 MCP 通道，客户端工具真的能跑。与 magpie-kuku-auth 的差异：后者走纯文本网页对话接口、直接拒绝工具；本插件走 genflowpro（sendmsg + 三条 SSE + MCP 回调），带 tools 的请求会返回 finish_reason tool_calls，工具结果回填后同一轮继续生成。支持流式，可复用已有库库登录态。
